prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity screenshot-like UI design proposal for the Yoyos NATIVE ANDROID order detail screen. Single portrait image at approximately 1080x2340 (phone ratio), front-on flat screen, no device frame, no perspective, no surrounding presentation board. This is a designed functional app screen, not a poster. Reference image is the current Yoyos app: preserve ONLY its charcoal/ivory/caramel identity, Inter-like typography, flat surfaces, bottom navigation character. REPLACE its oversized spacing, old hierarchy, duplicate settings control and layout. Dark canvas #1C1B1D; grouped surfaces #272528; primary text #EEE8DF; secondary muted warm gray; caramel primary #D5A16C with #1C1B1D text. Very discreet 1px separators, 8dp card corners, 6dp controls. Native calm compact commercial tool inspired by Shopify merchant app information hierarchy. Crisp legible Spanish, generous 48dp touch areas, content text 14-16 logical px, header 18-20, no huge money hero. Currency aligned right in tabular figures. Status bar 9:41. Native top bar back arrow, "Pedido #1042", overflow. Global bottom nav small clean outline icons "Inicio", "Productos", "Ventas" selected in caramel, "Ajustes"; respect bottom system gesture bar. No product photos, no fabricated integrations, no charts, no gradients, no progress stepper. Illustrative data: created "6 oct · 10:42", "Orden activa", "Pago pendiente", "Entrega pendiente"; buyer "Ana Torres"; 2 Polo algodón Negro / M at S/ 45 = S/ 90 and 1 Pantalón Azul / 32 at S/ 80 = S/ 80. Productos subtotal S/ 170, Envío S/ 10, Total S/ 180, Recibido S/ 80, Saldo S/ 100. One reported receipt has unknown amount, label "1 comprobante por revisar"; never mark it confirmed. Delivery is agency "Shalom · Miraflores", recipient "Luis Torres", distinct from buyer. Confirmation of buyer pending is distinct from payment. All UI exact, sober, premium, dense but readable. No proposal title or A/B/C label within the app screenshot.
STRUCTURE B, next pending task first. Under top bar compact date, order active and buyer Ana Torres, independent payment/delivery badges. A prominent but restrained grouped task panel "Requiere revisión", "1 comprobante recibido", "Verifica el importe antes de confirmar.", and filled caramel "Revisar comprobante". Beneath a stable summary list of groups: "Pedido" with "3 unidades" right, total S/ 180 and small preview "Polo algodón + Pantalón", "Ver productos" chevron. "Pago" with Recibido S/ 80 and "Saldo pendiente S/ 100", secondary outline "Registrar pago". "Entrega" with agency Shalom · Miraflores, recipient Luis Torres and text action "Editar". "Confirmación del comprador" / "Pendiente" / text "Obtener enlace". Last "Detalles internos" disclosure. Keep entire first screen well composed with task at top and the summaries visible below. Primary task review button dominates; other actions visually quieter. No photo of a receipt. No invented automation.
scope: Native order detail composition proposal; illustrative data; not an implemented screen.
implementationNotes: Keep native Android system chrome; generated status bar resembles iOS.
Use flat token colors without generated sheen.
Internal details contain stock and attribution; no notes feature is implied.
Buyer confirmation is performed by the buyer, not the seller.
Scale text and touch targets for device; generated comp is a composition reference.
